camel_example: aliyun csas UpdateAntiVirusRealTimeDefenceStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --MatchMode UserGroupNormal --MidRiskOperation Notify --ScanTargets.1 Virus --UserGroupIds.1 'usergroup-9d4f2a7b3c1e0000' --MaxCpuUsage 30 --HighRiskOperation Quarantine --Whitelist.1 '王先生' --LowRiskOperation None --method POST --force
description_en: Configures the real-time anti-virus defense policy for the current Alibaba Cloud account. The first call creates the policy, and subsequent calls update it. The complete updated configuration is returned. When configuring for the first time, Status, MatchMode, HighRiskOperation, MidRiskOperation, LowRiskOperation, and ScanTargets are all required. ScanTargets and Whitelist are full replacements. The collection you pass in replaces the existing configuration. When MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal, you must pass in the complete UserGroupIds on every call. When Status is not set to Disabled, the system validates the endpoint hardening license count. The call fails if the count exceeds the purchased licenses
description_zh: 配置当前阿里云账号的防病毒实时防御策略，首次调用时创建策略，之后调用更新策略，并返回更新后的完整配置。首次配置时Status、MatchMode、HighRiskOperation、MidRiskOperation、LowRiskOperation与ScanTargets均必须传入。ScanTargets与Whitelist为全量覆盖，传入的集合会替换原有配置；生效范围为UserGroupNormal时每次调用都必须重新传入完整的UserGroupIds。Status不为Disabled时会校验终端加固授权数，超出已购授权数时调用失败
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-anti-virus-real-time-defence-strategy --status Enabled --high-risk-operation Quarantine --mid-risk-operation Notify --low-risk-operation None --match-mode UserGroupNormal --scan-targets Virus --whitelist 王先生 --user-group-ids usergroup-9d4f2a7b3c1e0000 --max-cpu-usage 30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAntiVirusRealTimeDefenceStrategy

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用状态。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。取值：
Enabled：启用。
Disabled：停用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: high_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file
parameters.help_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件
parameters.name: mid_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Takes no action
parameters.help_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理
parameters.name: low_risk_operation

parameters.help_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups. UserGroupIds is required in this case
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效，此时UserGroupIds必填
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus types to be handled by real-time defense. Duplicates are not allowed. Required when configuring the real-time defense policy for the first time. When the policy already exists, this parameter performs a full replacement. The collection you pass in replaces the existing configuration
parameters.help_zh: 实时防御要处置的病毒类型集合，不允许重复。首次配置实时防御策略时必填。策略已存在时本参数为全量覆盖，传入的集合会替换原有配置
parameters.name: scan_targets

parameters.help_en: The exception user list. Users in this list are excluded from real-time defense. A maximum of 1000 entries are allowed. Duplicates are not allowed. This parameter performs a full replacement. The list you pass in replaces the existing list
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不启用实时防御。最多包含1000个，不允许重复。本参数为全量覆盖，传入的名单会替换原有名单
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs to which the policy applies. Required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal. Not allowed when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll. At least 1 and at most 100 entries are allowed. Duplicates are not allowed. When MatchMode is UserGroupNormal, you must pass in the complete user group collection on every call, even when modifying only other parameters
parameters.help_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。生效范围为UserGroupNormal时必填，为UserGroupAll时不允许传入。至少包含1个，最多包含100个，不允许重复。生效范围为UserGroupNormal的策略，每次调用都必须重新传入完整的用户组集合，仅修改其他参数时也必须一并传入
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum percentage of endpoint CPU that real-time defense can consume. Valid values: 0 to 100. When configuring for the first time, the value is stored as 0 but takes effect as 30
parameters.help_zh: 实时防御占用终端CPU的百分比上限。取值范围：0~100。首次配置时按0写入，实际下发按30生效
parameters.name: max_cpu_usage

HighRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file. Quarantine is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
HighRiskOperation.description_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Quarantine

LowRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Takes no action. None is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
LowRiskOperation.description_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回None

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups. An empty string is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空字符串

MidRiskOperation.description_en:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file. Notify is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
MidRiskOperation.description_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Notify

ScanTargets.description_en: The collection of virus types to be handled by real-time defense. An empty list is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
ScanTargets.description_zh: 实时防御要处置的病毒类型集合。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空列表

Status.description_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled. This value is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Disabled

StrategyId.description_en: The real-time defense policy ID. An empty string is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
StrategyId.description_zh: 实时防御策略ID。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空字符串

UserGroupIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs to which the policy applies. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

Whitelist.description_en: The exception user list. Users in this list are excluded from real-time defense. An empty list is returned if no exception users are configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不启用实时防御。未配置时返回空列表
